provenance: Four independent source-grounded occupational audit cases prepared before final correction freeze. Provisional authored labels, not expert ground truth. Compare baseline and final outputs without tuning against these cases; preserve first-run results and disclose misses. Apply the parent-approved blocking threshold of two or more paired regressions. Existing acceptance requirements remain unchanged.

cases.input: I examine pets to find the cause of illnesses and injuries, then prescribe medicines or perform surgery when needed. I also vaccinate animals and explain the treatment plan to their owners.
cases.rationale: Veterinarians: committed role description covers diagnosing and treating animal diseases and injuries. Tasks 4106, 4107 and 4108 cover examination, prescribed medication or surgery, and vaccination.

cases.input: I cut, color, and shape clients' hair, choosing styles that suit their hair type and preferences. Between appointments I clean the workstation and sanitize scissors, combs, and other tools.
cases.rationale: Hairdressers, Hairstylists, and Cosmetologists: committed description covers cutting, coloring and styling hair. Tasks 635, 636 and 637 cover sanitation, shaping hair according to client characteristics, and recommending styles.

cases.input: I convert spoken presentations and written documents between languages while preserving their meaning and tone. I resolve ambiguous expressions with the speakers or authors and keep confidential information private.
cases.rationale: Interpreters and Translators: committed description covers spoken interpretation and written translation. Tasks 9326, 9327 and 9328 cover confidentiality, resolving meaning conflicts, and preserving message content, context and style.

cases.input: I diagnose faults in cars with computerized test equipment and inspect components to decide what needs repairing. After replacing or adjusting parts, I test-drive the vehicle and check that the repaired systems meet performance specifications.
cases.rationale: Automotive Service Technicians and Mechanics: committed description covers diagnosing, adjusting and repairing vehicles. Tasks 23522, 23523 and 23524 cover computerized diagnosis, inspection, test driving and checking repaired systems against performance specifications.
